t: You're at the tomb of Blanche Roosevelt Macchetta in Brompton Cemetery, in Kensington and Chelsea. Blanche Roosevelt was an American opera singer, author and journalist, who died in 1898. She is best remembered for creating the role of Mabel in Gilbert and Sullivan's The Pirates of Penzance, when the opera premiered on Broadway in 1879. So this London grave belongs to a woman whose voice first brought one of the best-loved comic operas to an audience in New York.
